summary: A lightweight, self-hosted web dashboard and documentation hub built with FastAPI, optimized for Orange Pi Zero 3 SBC hardware with fully automated CI/CD deployment.
key_features: Async FastAPI backend with high performance
Server-side rendered responsive UI via Jinja2
Zero-touch CI/CD pipeline on push to main
Secure remote access via Tailscale mesh & Cloudflare Tunnel
achievements: Designed and implemented a secure, zero-touch CI/CD pipeline that authenticates via Tailscale, deploys via SSH, and manages systemd services without manual intervention. Engineered a secure networking architecture combining Tailscale for internal SSH access and Cloudflare Tunnel for public exposure, eliminating the need to open inbound firewall ports. Optimized application footprint and service configuration for reliable operation on resource-constrained SBC hardware.
